sources.title: G. H. J. Adlam, Acids, Alkalis and Salts
sources.role: Historical technical book; text and figures 3 and 13 examined.
sources.notes: The acid icon extracts the simple early chamber described in the historical account, excluding later towers shown in figure 3. The alkali icon simplifies a stationary masonry furnace, excluding rotary and Solvay equipment. Neither icon reproduces a complete industrial plant.

sources.notes: Model dates 1890–1894, later than the intended early process. Not copied.

Primary request: represent the early Leblanc alkali process with one compact STATIONARY reverberatory black-ash furnace, NOT a rotary furnace or a Solvay tower.
